title: Retractable Hooks And Garment Rod Wall Mount 2-1/2-Inch Solid Brass Carolina | Matte Black | Allied Brass
description:
Add space-saving hanging room with this wall mount retractable hooks and garment rod solution in Matte Black, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then pushes back in so it’s out of the way—ideal for bathroom coats, robes, and towels.

Highlights:
- Matte Black makes a bold, modern statement
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Rated to hold up to 15 lb
- Wall mount design supports versatile bath accessories and keeps items within reach
- Part of the Carolina collection for coordinated transitional bathroom hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Material: brass
- Mounting type: wall mount; fits standard interior walls
- Installation requires drilling one 3/4-inch diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around
- Hardware included: toggle bolts (6/32 toggles)
- Dimensions: 3.75-inch width x 1.75-inch height x 1.75-inch length; 1-inch projection
- Product weight: 1 lb
- Assembly required: no
- Available in multiple designer finish options, including statement colors
